title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Worksheet Note: Amount of the Restore Payment
content:
**Definition.** The restore payment is the member's own payment that brings a PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) meter disconnected for low balance back on, on an enrollment that carries no arrears balance; it is credited in full to the prepaid balance and carries no recovery portion. The restore payment the desk quotes is the restore target less the prepaid balance standing on the enrollment, plus the restore cushion, rounded to the cent, never less than the tier's smallest single payment and never more than its largest single payment.

**Quantities.**

1. *Restore target*: the tier's reconnect balance.
2. *Prepaid balance standing on the enrollment*: the balance at the time of the quote, which may be below zero; subtracting a balance below zero adds its amount.
3. *Cushion daily cost*: the total of the enrollment's daily charge lines in the one-month window divided by the number of service days those lines cover in that window. A window of a stated number of months takes the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, through the current date.
4. *Cushion days*: zero.
5. *Restore cushion*: the cushion days multiplied by the cushion daily cost, rounded to the cent.
6. *Restore payment*: the restore target less the prepaid balance, plus the restore cushion, rounded to the cent, then held between the tier's smallest and largest single payments.

### Worked figures (hypothetical records; for illustration a reconnect balance of 10.00, a smallest single payment of 10.00 and a largest of 500.00)

| Prepaid balance standing | Target less balance | Restore cushion | Before the payment limits | Quoted restore payment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| -14.30 | 24.30 | 0.00 | 24.30 | 24.30 |
| 6.00 | 4.00 | 0.00 | 4.00 | 10.00 (raised to the smallest payment) |
| -612.00 | 622.00 | 0.00 | 622.00 | 500.00 (held to the largest payment) |
